**Behavior delivered**
- Delivery checkout (new/reorder) now runs the shared `completeCheckout`: starts payment exactly once and opens `#payment/<id>` with a fresh 30-min reservation; collection stays confirmed/unpaid on `#result`. Repeated reorder submission reuses the linked order/reservation/deadline.
- `canReorder` requires an actual expired/released delivery reservation; never-started payment offers "Proceed to payment" (no false expiry).
- Result/order copy is state-truthful (collection paid/completed/cancelled; delivery dispatched/delivered no future-dispatch claim). "Decline this order" is a native `<button>`.
- Cart allows delivery checkout with an available item before any address: "Calculated at checkout" + "Total before delivery", never fake free delivery; unavailable rows still block; address/tariff validation on submit unchanged.
- S-03 Items tables wrapped in `.table-scroll` (block scroll container; table stays `display:table`), staff + guest order views; diagnostics token rewritten to spaced copy.
- S-04 return labels associated with controls via `for`/`id` from `escapeHtml(order.id)`.
